purpose: Public-key references of kv_ledger_head_signer (StegVerse-Labs/TVC#542): every KV and SKAP Vault ledger head is signed by this role. llm_adapter.endpoint_ledger_designation accepts a KV or SKAP_VAULT ledger read only when its head carries an Ed25519 stegverse.kv-ledger-head-attestation/v1 by one of these keys (StegVerse-org/.github#160 comment 6372216673).
custody: TV/TVC. Keys are generated and held by TV/TVC custody for the kv_ledger_head_signer role only; bots and this repository never hold key material. A reference is added here only by an admitted change carrying TV/TVC's publication receipt.
state: NONE_PUBLISHED: no kv_ledger_head_signer is published, so every KV and SKAP_VAULT ledger read is FAIL_CLOSED KV_LEDGER_HEAD_SIGNER_NOT_PUBLISHED.
